description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to assertion control within the Thunder namespace, including singleton management, assertion event handling, and category type definitions.

classes.name: AssertionUnitProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing assertion units, singleton pattern, handling assertion events.

classes.name: BaseAssertType
classes.description: Represents an assertion category type with enable/disable control and metadata, singleton pattern.

classes.name: AssertionControl
classes.description: Nested class within BaseAssertType, manages assertion category enable/disable state and metadata.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the assertion category is enabled.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the assertion category.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the assertion category.

methods.name: AssertionEvent
methods.description: Processes an assertion event with metadata and message.
